entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return something. I bought a pair of cycling shoes a while back and... they're just not right. I'm so disappointed.

I'm certainly sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I've tried everything, moving the cleats around, different insoles... but they just give me terrible blisters on every single ride. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for these. I just... I really needed this money back.

I completely understand. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and comfort is key. Let me check on the return eligibility for you right away. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered 69 days ago. I've just checked our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, you can? That's... such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you so much.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just initiated that return for you. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help, Isaac. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
